messages:
emma_devex: Heads up — starting the SDK publish quiet window in 10m (2026-03-21 22:00 UTC). python & ts canaries scheduled. Do not merge any publish-related PRs after T+5m.

emma_devex: Also FYI we rotated the ephemeral upload creds this morning. double-check CI secret: SDK_UPLOAD_TOKEN.

deploy-bot: publish-request received for package @redwood/sdk-js (canary). pipeline: canary-publish-4100001234. status: queued.

sanjay_releases: copying in CI logs, can we gate on signature checks? saw a single failed wheel checksum earlier on staging.

marta_docs: if there's a signer drift we should freeze dist-tags until we confirm. suggestion: pin dist-tag to previous stable for consumers.

leo_eng: Log snippet from the twine step:```Uploading distribution to https://upload.pypi.org/legacy/  HTTPError: 400 Client Error: File signature mismatch``` — looks like one artifact got signed with old key. not all artifacts failed.

emma_devex: ugh. Are canaries already routing traffic? deploy-bot, which ones went live?

deploy-bot: canary-publish-4100001234 for @redwood/sdk-js completed -> deployed to canary edge (10% traffic). @redwood/sdk-py canary failed during upload.

sanjay_releases: proposal: stop further py publishes, pin python dist-tag to 1.12.3 (previous). proceed with ts canaries only. We can republish py after re-signing.

leo_eng: I can re-sign and re-upload a fixed wheel within ~30m, but only if we stop the pipeline from continuing to publish more variants. also need to rotate CI token in the job to use new key.

marta_docs: we should also hold off on announcement and changelog cut until both lang canaries are green. avoids confusion.

emma_devex: decision: pause python publishes + pin dist-tag to 1.12.3. let ts canaries continue. I'll open a short rollback/pin PR and notify support.

emma_devex: PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference-sdk/pull/987 — pin py dist-tag, add rollback criteria.

sanjay_releases: ack. I will create an issue to track re-sign and republish: INF-2152. tagging leo and oncall.

leo_eng: started re-sign job locally, uploading to a staging bucket now. will coordinate with CI for redeploy. ETA 25m.

oncall-bot: reminder: we have SLA alerting muted for quiet window (22:00-23:00 UTC).

deploy-bot: update: ts canary-publish-4100001234 succeeded and is at 10% traffic. python publish jobs were canceled per request.

emma_devex: thanks. after leo confirms re-upload I'll run a smoke canary and then unpin dist-tag. For now: support notified, docs hold.

leo_eng: fixed wheel uploaded to staging and verified checksums. CI redeploy triggered: canary-republish-4100001300.

deploy-bot: canary-republish-4100001300 for @redwood/sdk-py passed artifact verification and deployed to canary (5% traffic) — no signature errors observed.

marta_docs: when we flip dist-tag back, I'll coordinate changelog and release note. please ping me.

emma_devex: final decision: unpin tomorrow morning in main window. for now we leave dist-tag pinned and mark this as "postmortem-lite" item on INF-2152. thanks all :thumbsup:

sanjay_releases: noted. tagging with release-metrics to check if any downstream pipelines consumed the bad wheel.

deploy-bot: thread closed: publish window complete.
